name: use-entitlements
title: useFeatureGate
description: useFeatureGate: the entitlements block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the entitlements block (`npx better-supabase add entitlements`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/entitlements.
